name: manual_774d6e
claim: When a git-worktree cleanup path falls back to plain recursive delete because the proper removal command failed, that fallback does not clear git's internal worktree admin registration -- only the dedicated prune command does; omitting it leaves stale worktree/detached-HEAD metadata that accumulates across every failed removal.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review 4890542470 on orama PR #298 reproduced this empirically (a disposable-repo probe showing the recursive-delete fallback on the worktree dir leaves the admin record registered until an explicit prune runs). Fixed cherry-reanchor-branches.sh's cleanup function to prune after the remove/delete fallback, and consolidated 3 duplicate inline cleanup call sites in the same script to reuse the one fixed function instead of re-implementing the same (buggy) sequence.
